name: DWP — Households Below Average Income, FYE 1995 to FYE 2025
raw_note: raw/ vendors the summary tables plus the four population/children/workingage/pensioners timeseries files extracted from the data-tables zip (the region/country low-income tables); the remaining zip contents (material deprivation, disability, food security, income distribution) are not yet vendored.

model.name: HBAI (FRS-based income statistics)
model.method: Survey estimates from the Family Resources Survey: equivalised (OECD-companion scale) net disposable household income, before and after housing costs. Relative low income = below 60% of contemporary median; absolute low income = below 60% of an FYE 2011 median held fixed in real terms (rebased from FYE 2021 at the 2021/22 series break). From 2021/22 the series integrates benefit administrative data with the survey.
model.method_basis: HBAI background information and methodology report FYE 2025; Guidance sheet in the summary tables

period: Single years FYE 1995 to FYE 2025 (UK from 2002/03, GB before); region/country tables are 3-year rolling averages
geographies: UK + GB (pre-2002/03) + 12 English regions/countries (England, 9 English regions, Wales, Scotland, Northern Ireland); 3-year averages only below UK level
vintage_note: Series break at 2021/22: integrated survey and benefit admin data, and a change in the absolute-poverty base year. FYE 2021 survey year is affected by COVID field-work disruption. Always score against this release's restatement of earlier years, not earlier releases.
diagnosis_upstream: HBAI is a survey statistic, not a simulation; divergence diagnoses classify against FRS/PE-data differences (enhanced FRS reweighting, imputation) rather than a policy engine.
